scoring_justification: The checker cannot re-run the MD simulation; it verifies structural properties (dominance, spatial anisotropy, peak existence) from the submitted numerical artifacts, which are the paper's main findings.

outputs.description: Static structure factors F_αβ(Q,t=0) for 470 K at five Q vectors; used to verify that Ag–Ag correlations dominate (at least 10× larger than any other pair).

Zero-energy neutron intensity S(Q,0) for three temperatures and five Q vectors, plus the quasi-elastic peak FWHM at Q=(1.6,1,0) for each temperature. Used to verify the spatial pattern, temperature trend, and the monotonic increase of the linewidth with temperature.
S(Q,ω) curves for Q=(1.8,1,0) spanning 0–10 meV; checked for a distinct low-energy peak around 3 meV at 268 K and its broadening or disappearance at 470 K.
Detected low-energy excitation peak positions; the 268 K peak must lie in the 2–4 meV range, and the 470 K entry must be null.

output_contract.notes: All checks are structural and comparison-based: the verifier reads the submitted CSVs/JSON and confirms (i) Ag–Ag dominance, (ii) S_zero spatial pattern, (iii) FWHM of the quasi-elastic peak increases monotonically with temperature, (iv) low-energy peak existence and energy range, without requiring exact numeric agreement with the paper.

steps.description: Verify that for each Q, F_AgAg is at least 10 times larger than any other F_αβ.
Verify spatial pattern: maximum S_zero at (1.6,1,0) for 470K, faster decrease along h than k, and monotonic temperature increase.
Verify S(Q,ω) curves show a distinct low-energy peak for 268K and 339K in 0-5 meV range, and no peak (monotonically decreasing) for 470K.
Verify reported peak energies: 268K peak between 2.5-4.0 meV, 339K peak between 2.0-3.5 meV or null, 470K entry null.
